boards.title: 01 — Sodda
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile application concept board for ILBI, an Uzbek retail sales, inventory, cashbox and customer-debt platform. This is a practical React Native app design exploration, not a marketing landing page.
Composition: wide landscape presentation at high resolution, THREE complete upright powered-on smartphone mockups in one straight horizontal row, generous consistent gaps, equal scale, no overlaps, no cropping. First and third phones have a subtle modern iPhone frame with a small top camera cutout, middle phone has a modern Android frame with a small centered hole-punch camera. Front-facing, virtually no perspective, screens fill most of each phone. All three phones use one coherent design system. Include realistic status bars at 9:41, safe areas and bottom system gesture indicators. Pale neutral studio background, subtle realistic phone shadows, crisp flat UI inside screens. Clearly readable UI, large type, comfortable whitespace, touch targets at least approximately 44pt, consistent restrained line icons, practical spacing. The screen designs must be implementable with ordinary performant native components: solid surfaces, modest rounding, no expensive background blur, no decorative 3D objects. Render Uzbek Latin UI labels verbatim and correctly, amounts in "so'm". Use the existing brand name "ILBI" as a simple text wordmark, not a newly invented logo. Include only the requested content, no fake lorem ipsum, no gibberish, no watermarks. Functional semantic colors: green successful, amber low stock, red overdue. Any demo numbers must be internally consistent. All data is synthetic.

Primary request: Concept 01, the clean everyday all-rounder. White canvas, ILBI cobalt blue #006bff primary actions, near-black text, faint cool-gray dividers, moderate 16px card radii, polished but calm. Give the board a discreet heading outside phones "01 — SODDA".
Phone 1 / caption "Bosh sahifa": header "ILBI", store selector "Markaziy do'kon", bell icon; greeting "Xayrli tong, Aziz". One strong sales summary "Bugungi savdo" and "2 450 000 so'm", small "+12%" indicator. Two quiet metrics "Savdolar 24" and "Qarzdorlik 860 000". Large blue "Yangi savdo" button. Three quick action tiles "Tovar", "Qarz", "Hisobot". A "So'nggi savdolar" section with two compact legible receipt rows. Bottom navigation with icon + labels "Bosh", "Tovar", "Savdo", "Qarz", "Yana"; Bosh selected.
Phone 2 / caption "Mahsulotlar": title "Tovarlar"; generous search "Tovar qidirish", scan barcode icon; short category chips "Barchasi", "Ichimlik", "Oziq-ovqat". Four spacious product rows with tiny simple product thumbnails, title, price and stock. Exact products "Sut 1 L" "12 000 so'm" "Qoldiq: 18", "Non" "4 000 so'm" "Qoldiq: 32", "Suv 1.5 L" "5 000 so'm" "Qoldiq: 24", "Shakar 1 kg" "16 000 so'm" "Qoldiq: 3" with amber low-stock badge. Clear add buttons. Tovar tab selected.
Phone 3 / caption "Savat": header "Yangi savdo"; two cart lines "Sut 1 L", quantity stepper 2, line total "24 000 so'm"; "Non", quantity stepper 3, line total "12 000 so'm". Customer picker "Mijoz tanlash". Payment choices "Naqd", "Karta", "Nasiya", Naqd selected. Bottom summary "Jami" "36 000 so'm", anchored blue action "Savdoni yakunlash". Composition must feel simple, immediately understandable and genuinely usable rather than overly dense.

Primary request: A motion-design storyboard for the ILBI React Native mobile point-of-sale app, showing THREE sequential keyframes of the SAME screen and the SAME action, not three separate concepts. Static storyboard illustrating a future short microanimation, do not pretend the raster image is an actual video. Use white and cobalt design matching a restrained fast mobile POS. Board heading outside phones "06 — ANIMATSIYA OQIMI". Small clear rightward arrows BETWEEN phone frames. Caption under each phone exactly "1. Tovarni tanlash", "2. Savatga o'tish", "3. Qo'shildi". Small footnote at bottom outside phones exactly "180–220 ms · qisqa o'tish · yengil tasdiq".
Every phone shows same "Yangi savdo" screen, search "Tovar qidirish", product row "Sut 1 L" "12 000 so'm" and "Non" "4 000 so'm", a simple "+", and bottom blue cart bar. Maintain exact screen geometry across all three keyframes.
Frame 1: product milk row is being selected with a tiny restrained touch ring on its plus button, bottom cart bar "Savat · 0 dona" and "0 so'm".
Frame 2: show a small milk thumbnail midway along a short fine dotted motion path from the product plus to the cart icon in the bottom blue bar. This movement is a storyboard annotation, not a decorative app feature. No huge swooshes, no motion blur, no confetti. Cart total may remain "0 so'm" as transition is in progress.
Frame 3: milk row returns to its normal stable state, bottom cart bar shows "Savat · 1 dona" and "12 000 so'm", cart count has a tiny restrained emphasis ring; compact success toast just above cart says "Savatga qo'shildi" with small green check.
Make it explicit visually that the user receives immediate feedback and can continue working, no full-screen loading, no blocking splash animation.
